wins: Identified exposed SMB share on 10.0.5.12 and documented reachable file paths for later exploitation.
Executed multi-host scanning sweep with masscan followed by focused nmap timing profile, completing in under 12 minutes despite network anomalies.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges after compromising service account due to missing local privilege escalation binaries.
Unable to maintain persistence; scheduled tasks deployment detected and rolled back in subsequent monitoring.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase completed with high visibility into external services, but follow-up exploitation/stability actions need refinement to convert into success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stagnation after initial foothold, likely due to missing exploitation tooling and privilege limitations.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB named pipe access responds without authentication
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate shares via smbclient and map writable directories before mounting

skill_cards.if_condition: When Windows domain services detected and Kerberos AS-REQs available
skill_cards.then_action: Request TGT with impacket-getTGT followed by AS-REP roast of non-preauth users

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH reconnaissance phase and repeatable nmap scripting pattern.
Consistent SMB share discovery drove subsequent data collection opportunities.

next_experiments.title: Post-exploitation toolchain audit
next_experiments.description: Verify availability of local privilege escalation binaries (juicy potato, mimikatz) on target path and stage execution via scheduled task to bypass AV.

next_experiments.title: Persistence hardening test
next_experiments.description: Deploy alternate persistence via WMI subscription and monitor for detection before reapplying to confirm rollback behavior is trackable.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvest verification
next_experiments.description: Capture NTLM hashes from SMB connections using responder + Inveigh to validate ability to re-use for lateral movement.
